description: This Java source file defines a utility class `CommonEnumerations` with static methods to generate `EnumOptionData` objects for various enumeration types used across the application, such as period frequency, condition types, days in month/year, and general enumerations. It provides methods to retrieve specific enumeration options based on IDs or types, which are typically used for UI dropdowns or for consistent internal representation of enumerated constants.

classes.name: CommonEnumerations
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to generate enumeration option data for various types such as frequency, condition, days in month/year, and general enums.

methods.name: commonEnumueration
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData based on the provided type name and ID, namely for days in month or days in year.

methods.name: termFrequencyType (int id, String codePrefix)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a period frequency type (days, weeks, months, years) based on an integer ID.

methods.name: termFrequencyType (PeriodFrequencyType type, String codePrefix)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a given PeriodFrequencyType, with a prefix for the code.

methods.name: conditionType (int id, String codePrefix)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a condition type based on an integer ID.

methods.name: conditionType (ConditionType type, String codePrefix)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a given ConditionType enum instance.

methods.name: conditionType (ConditionType[] conditionTypes, String codePrefix)
methods.description: Converts an array of ConditionType enums into a list of EnumOptionData, filtering out invalids.

methods.name: daysInMonthType (int id)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData based on an integer ID for days in month type.

methods.name: daysInMonthType (DaysInMonthType type)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a specified DaysInMonthType enum.

methods.name: daysInYearType (int id)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData based on an integer ID for days in year type.

methods.name: daysInYearType (DaysInYearType type)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a specified DaysInYearType enum.
